description:
Decoder-only transformer configuration (spec B2).

Defaults are the 2026 "architecture that won" for small decoder-only LMs:
RoPE + RMSNorm + SwiGLU + GQA + QK-norm, untied head, zero-init output projections.
The modded-nanoGPT speedrun extras (ReLU^2 MLP, logit soft-cap, MTP head) are
toggles so that Phase 5 can *measure* them rather than assert them.

n_kv_heads.description: Number of key/value heads (GQA). Must divide n_heads.
n_kv_heads.title: N Kv Heads

d_ff.description: Feed-forward hidden width. If None it is derived as a multiple of d_model (8/3 for SwiGLU so that parameter count matches a 4x non-gated MLP).
d_ff.title: D Ff

mlp_type.description: SwiGLU default; ReLU^2 is the modded-nanoGPT speedrun variant.
mlp_type.title: Mlp Type

qk_norm.description: RMS-normalize q and k before the dot product.
qk_norm.title: Qk Norm

tie_embeddings.description: Untied LM head by default (speedrun stack).
tie_embeddings.title: Tie Embeddings

zero_init_output.description: Zero-init attention/MLP output projections and the LM head (muP-like).
zero_init_output.title: Zero Init Output

logit_soft_cap.description: If set, apply c*tanh(logits/c) (Gemma-2 style). None disables it.
logit_soft_cap.title: Logit Soft Cap

n_mtp_heads.description: Extra multi-token-prediction heads predicting t+2, t+3, ... Used both as a training-quality ablation and, in Arc 2, as a self-speculation draft.
n_mtp_heads.title: N Mtp Heads

mtp_loss_weight.description: Weight of the auxiliary MTP loss.
mtp_loss_weight.title: Mtp Loss Weight

dropout.description: Dropout is off by default at this scale.
dropout.title: Dropout

attn_impl.description: 'manual' is the from-scratch reference path. 'sdpa' is an optional fast path that must match 'manual' numerically (tested in tests/unit/test_attention.py).
attn_impl.title: Attn Impl

title: ModelConfig
